CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.
   D. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5.
   B. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of the Paralytic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of the Paralytic.
   B. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Healing of the Paralytic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Healing of the Paralytic to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Lost Sheep? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Lost Sheep to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Lost Sheep with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Lost Sheep has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Lost Sheep.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.
   B. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Say Calming the Storm has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.
   C. Apply the teaching of Calming the Storm with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership in Israel: Saul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Calming the Storm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Healing of the Paralytic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
